shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 3 on the number line on the left with the mark at (1,4) on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed set excludes 3 at its upper bound. Right image: The point (1,4) is excluded while the same input is still defined by f(1)=−1.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray. On the right, the hollow marker excludes its plotted height only. The filled marker vertically aligned with it supplies the actual output at that input.
